breve: A sub-tree of many type AnimationNodes used for complex animations. Used by AnimationTree.
descricao:
This animation node may contain a sub-tree of any other type animation nodes, such as AnimationNodeTransition, AnimationNodeBlend2, AnimationNodeBlend3, AnimationNodeOneShot, etc. This is one of the most commonly used animation node roots.
An AnimationNodeOutput node named output is created by default.

metodos.assinatura: add_node(name: StringName, node: AnimationNode, position: Vector2 = Vector2(0, 0)) -> void
metodos.desc: Adds an AnimationNode at the given 'position'. The 'name' is used to identify the created sub animation node later.

metodos.assinatura: connect_node(input_node: StringName, input_index: int, output_node: StringName) -> void
metodos.desc: Connects the output of an AnimationNode as input for another AnimationNode, at the input port specified by 'input_index'.
Disconnects the animation node connected to the specified input.
Returns the sub animation node with the specified 'name'.
Returns a list containing the names of all sub animation nodes in this blend tree.
Returns the position of the sub animation node with the specified 'name'.
Returns true if a sub animation node with specified 'name' exists.
Changes the name of a sub animation node.
Modifies the position of a sub animation node.

propriedades.desc: The global offset of all sub animation nodes.

sinais.desc: Emitted when the input port information is changed.

constantes.desc: The specified input port is out of range.
